title: Squarespace Commerce
meta: Products, checkout, shipping and tax set up for your Squarespace online store, ready for its first order. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
overview: We set up the selling side of your Squarespace site: products with photos and options, categories, checkout, payment provider, shipping rates and tax settings. We also check the order emails customers receive and test a real purchase from start to finish. You get a store you can run on your own, plus a short guide for adding products, handling orders and issuing refunds.

faq: Which Squarespace plan do I need to sell?
You need a Business or Commerce plan to sell. Commerce plans have no extra Squarespace transaction fee. Plans and prices change, so we check your account and tell you which one fits before we set up.
Can you import my products from another store?

Yes. Send a CSV from Shopify, WooCommerce or another tool and we map it to Squarespace's product format, then check images and variants. Squarespace limits some fields, so a few items may need manual care.
Do you set up payments in my name?
We connect the provider inside your account, and you complete their sign-up and identity checks yourself. We never touch your bank details or passwords.
Can you set up shipping for different countries?
Yes. We create shipping zones and rates by region and add tax settings, but you confirm what you charge and what tax rules apply to you. We do not give tax advice.
